about: Hourly electricity demand and the capacity factors of solar and wind power in 2025 on three U.S. grids, from the U.S. Energy Information Administration (Forms EIA-930 and EIA-860M; public domain). demand is in hundredths of a gigawatt; sun and wind are capacity factors in thousandths. Hour 0 is midnight to 1 a.m. Eastern Standard Time on January 1, 2025. Made by models/grid/build_data.py.
